normal_walk: A human person is walking normally at an everyday steady pace, taking alternating steps without running or interacting with another person.
An ordinary human walking action: relaxed upright posture and regular alternating leg steps.
A single pedestrian moves by normal walking, with controlled arm swing and no chase, push, or fight.
A person travels on foot at a calm walking pace rather than sprinting.
Normal human locomotion by walking: one person steadily takes consecutive steps.
normal_run: A human person is running quickly, with a clear faster gait and repeated rapid strides, not chasing or fighting another person.
An ordinary human running action: rapid alternating strides and energetic arm movement.
A single runner moves at a sustained running pace without physical interaction with another person.
A person travels on foot by running or jogging rather than walking.
Normal human locomotion by running: one person repeatedly takes fast strides.
playful_chase: Two or more human people are playfully chasing each other, running after and evading one another in a non-hostile game.
A friendly game of chase between people: one person pursues while another person runs away playfully.
Multiple humans move quickly in a playful pursuit, with no fight or aggressive confrontation.
Children or people are happily running after one another as part of a game.
A non-aggressive human chase: at least two people pursue and evade each other playfully.
playful_push: Two or more human people are playfully pushing or gently shoving each other in a friendly non-hostile interaction.
A friendly playful push between people: brief light shoves without a fight or aggression.
Multiple humans interact face to face with joking pushes and relaxed body language.
Children or people are playfully nudging and pushing one another as a game.
A non-aggressive physical interaction where at least two people lightly push or shove each other.
conflict_chase: Two or more human people are in a hostile conflict chase, where one person forcefully pursues another who tries to escape.
An aggressive pursuit between people: a person chases another during a confrontation rather than a game.
Multiple humans run in a tense hostile chase with pursuit and escape behavior.
A person is fleeing while another person aggressively runs after them in a conflict.
A confrontational human chase: at least two people are involved in hostile pursuit and evasion.
conflict_push: Two or more human people are in a hostile physical confrontation, forcefully pushing or shoving each other.
An aggressive push or shove between people during a conflict or fight.
Multiple humans confront each other face to face with forceful pushing and defensive reactions.
A person forcefully pushes another person as part of a hostile altercation.
A confrontational human interaction where at least two people physically shove or push each other.
